title: Cluster craft
description: This resource pack is for 1.20+version and is aimed for pvp,boosting performance with asthetic looks
body:
# Cluster craft This time I present you a great PvP pack. This is a texture pack gives a simple texture for the armor,sword and tools in minecraft it's gives you new look and new and simple way of pvp armor

Requirements

Optifine required otherwise this pack doesn't work properly.
changes in minecraft after applying the pack.
changes are:-
1)Netherite armour
2)Netherite Sword
3)Diamod armour
4)Diamond Sword
5)Iron armor
6)Iron
7)Shield
this pack is supported both single player world and multiplayer servers.
version supported - 1.20
make sure you check the file version before downloading the pack all versions have separate files
Enjoy the "cluster pack".

THANKS FOR DOWNLOAD.
